producer: analysis/fork_check.py (branch identity and run checks), analysis/bld06_live_compare.py (graph quality, plans/bld06_live_prereg.json)

controls.supplier: CausalArena semantic test scenarios (datasets/suite_q1s2), real / neutral / swapped arms per datasets/suite_q1s2/MAPPING.json
controls.knowledge_source: variable names read by GPT-4o inside Causal-Copilot (branch bld-06-refinement-v2 or unmodified main)

metric_defs.adj_f1: F1 over unordered adjacencies against the data's reference (analysis/cc_graph.score)
metric_defs.dir_f1: F1 over directed edges, committed directions only
metric_defs.delivered_dir_f1: final dir_f1, a run that delivered no final graph scores 0

orientation_rule: only committed directions count; an undirected pair is no prediction; a two-way conflict predicts both (analysis/cc_graph.py score())
